union_exists:
select STRAIGHT_JOIN 
  cd_gender,
  cd_marital_status,
  cd_education_status,
  count(*) cnt1,
  cd_purchase_estimate,
  count(*) cnt2,
  cd_credit_rating,
  count(*) cnt3,
  cd_dep_count,
  count(*) cnt4,
  cd_dep_employed_count,
  count(*) cnt5,
  cd_dep_college_count,
  count(*) cnt6
 from
  customer_address ca,customer c,customer_demographics
 where
  c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk and
  ca_county in ('Madison County','Wallowa County','Calhoun County','Broadwater County','McCone County') and
  cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk and 
  exists (select *
          from store_sales,date_dim
          where c.c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk and
                ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2452001 AND 2452122 and
                d_year = 2001 and
                d_moy between 4 and 4+3) and
 EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_sales w JOIN date_dim d ON w.ws_sold_date_sk=d.d_date_sk
WHERE w.ws_bill_customer_sk=c.c_customer_sk AND d.d_year=2001 AND d.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 7
AND w.ws_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2452001 AND 2452122
UNION ALL
SELECT 1 FROM catalog_sales k JOIN date_dim d ON k.cs_sold_date_sk=d.d_date_sk
WHERE k.cs_ship_customer_sk=c.c_customer_sk AND d.d_year=2001 AND d.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 7
AND k.cs_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2452001 AND 2452122)
 group by cd_gender,
          cd_marital_status,
          cd_education_status,
          cd_purchase_estimate,
          cd_credit_rating,
          cd_dep_count,
          cd_dep_employed_count,
          cd_dep_college_count
 order by cd_gender,
          cd_marital_status,
          cd_education_status,
          cd_purchase_estimate,
          cd_credit_rating,
          cd_dep_count,
          cd_dep_employed_count,
          cd_dep_college_count
limit 100;
